decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler sits close to the core offer, so carrying it costs little while its value is still uncertain one year after launch.
The air cooled condenser shares the core platform and has low carrying cost, but it overlaps with Product C, which raises some chance of consolidation.
As a near-duplicate of Product B, it is the more likely of the two to be merged or dropped, though the cheap option is still worth holding while uncertainty lasts.
The tube liner extends the firm's lifecycle service business at low cost, and there is no evidence yet that its value will fail to materialize.
Customized air coolers are central to the firm's integrated-solutions strategy and cost little to keep listed.
Tube end repair inserts complement the service and spare parts business, making this a cheap option with unresolved upside.
